title: Reverb Core (R-Core)
summary: One reverb shared by many tracks, louder or softer in each part of the song.
steps: Select the tracks that should share the space.
Effects > Reverb: choose a place for your style.
Core makes one reverb track and sends each track to it.
The reverb gets quieter in the drops and opens up in the intro, breaks and build-ups. You can see and change it in the song.
